## Summary

- **`image-generation.adapter.ts`**: Add `!response.ok` guard before `.json()` so HTTP 4xx/5xx errors surface as `IMAGE_NETWORK_ERROR` rather than a misleading `IMAGE_RESPONSE_INVALID` Zod mismatch.
- **`generate-pipeline.ts`**: Add `!imageResponse.ok` guard and return `IMAGE_HTTP_ERROR` early; fix `status: imageResponse.status || 502` → `status: 502` (at that point `imageResponse.status` is 2xx, which would be wrong to propagate as the error status).
- **`http-client.ts`**: Add `!response.ok` check so callers see the HTTP status code in the thrown error instead of a generic "failed to parse JSON response" message.
- **`app-config-seam`**: Pass `undefined` (not `NaN`) when `MAX_IMAGES_PER_REQUEST` env var is absent; add `.default(4)` to the Zod schema so a missing var degrades gracefully instead of throwing on every config read.

## Test plan

- [ ] `npm test` — all 382 tests pass (1 integration test skipped by env gate)
- [ ] `npm run check` — 0 errors, 0 warnings
- [ ] Existing tests updated to assert the new, correct error codes (`IMAGE_HTTP_ERROR`) and error messages (`postJson: HTTP <status> from <url>`)

## Summary by Sourcery

Improve robustness and clarity of HTTP and image-generation error handling while making app configuration parsing safer by default.

Bug Fixes:
- Ensure HTTP client propagates non-ok HTTP statuses with clear error messages instead of generic JSON parsing failures.
- Return IMAGE_NETWORK_ERROR when the image generation adapter receives a non-ok HTTP response instead of misclassifying it as a schema validation error.
- Return IMAGE_HTTP_ERROR from the generate pipeline when the image service responds with a non-ok HTTP status and avoid propagating success status codes for error responses.
- Avoid treating an absent MAX_IMAGES_PER_REQUEST environment variable as NaN by passing undefined instead.

Enhancements:
- Set a default of 4 for maxImagesPerRequest in the configuration schema so missing configuration degrades gracefully without runtime failures.

Tests:
- Update and extend unit tests for the HTTP client and generate pipeline to assert the new error codes and messages and to cover non-ok response handling.
